# Marcus Results

> Paid advertising agency for Australian home services trades. Based in Brisbane, QLD. Founded 2021. Google Ads certified.

Marcus Results runs Google Ads and Meta ad campaigns for Australian home services businesses that work on the outside of homes: landscapers, house washers, concreters, roofers, tree services, exterior painters, fencers, pavers and auto detailers. Unlike lead-selling platforms such as Hipages, Oneflare and Service Seekers, leads are never shared. Every job goes to one client only, pre-qualified and ready to book.

## What makes Marcus Results different

- Specialises in outdoor home services trades, not general marketing
- Leads are exclusive to each client, never sold to several tradies at once like Hipages or Oneflare
- Every build includes a service-specific landing page, missed-call recovery and NFC review cards
- 19-day lead guarantee: if no lead arrives within 19 days, Marcus Results works free until one does
- Month-to-month contracts only, no lock-ins
- Turns down roughly 60% of enquiries to protect results

## Proven results

- Brisbane landscaper: booked $50,000 of work in the first month at a $50.98 cost per booked job, then grew revenue 5x
- Brisbane house washer: scaled from a solo owner-operator to a new hire and a second vehicle in 60 days
- European auto detailer: cost per lead dropped from $255 to $34
- More than $250,000 in ad spend managed for clients each year
- 14 days average from signed contract to live campaigns

## Services

Every package includes Google Ads setup and management, ad copy, call and form tracking, weekly search term checks, service landing pages, a filming guide, an onboarding strategy session and a monthly report and call. Website builds, AI overview integration and Google Business Profile ranking are add-ons.

- Minimum: $3,900/month. Up to 2 service landing pages. Minimum ad spend $75 a day.
- Growth: $4,500/month. Everything in Minimum plus Meta ads on Facebook and Instagram, up to 4 service landing pages, a half day shoot each month (4 to 6 videos plus photos) and scripts for every shoot. Minimum ad spend $100 a day. Most picked package.
- Scale: $9,000/month. Everything in Growth plus seasonal campaigns, unlimited service landing pages, up to 2 full shoot days a month handled for you (food and drinks included), 12 organic Facebook and Instagram posts a month and a quarterly strategy session. Minimum ad spend $300 a day.
- Management fees exclude advertising spend. Prices plus GST.

## Industries served

Landscaping, house washing, concreting, roofing, tree services, exterior painting, fencing, paving and auto detailing. Other outdoor home services considered on enquiry.

## Areas served

Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Ipswich and Logan, plus Australia wide.
